evidence.ambition: shot-02s: one flat 2D layer with a soft drop shadow on cream paper and a domain-warped band texture; by shot-20s a mirror fold reflects the cloth into a second composition step.
evidence.craft: shot-20s: moire and aliasing shimmer along the fold seam where the bands meet, and the warped stripes blur at the edges; the cream ground and indigo palette otherwise stay clean.
evidence.distinctness: shot-02s: indigo and cream cloth on paper with one tilted rectangle; the recent nights are apricot grids, coral and kite tilings, so this palette and cloth idea share nothing with them.

pairwise_justification: Tonight's shot-08s has crisp undyed bands on indigo cloth; the median's apricot grid is a muddy orange blob on tan noise, so tonight wins a head-to-head vote on clarity.

Keep the settled end state as the full centred diagonal rectangle the brief describes, instead of the mirrored V at shot-20s, so the start and end frames read as one object.
Make the wrap pitch visibly drift from dense to sparse across shot-02s and shot-08s, so the spacing rule reads without captions instead of as uniform wavy stripes.
